title: Ines and the Spire
author: Isandro Lockridge
blurb: Ulyana Crane, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
